abort_rules.when: An installed build, rig config revision or render rate differs from requires.
No sign-off covers the session, or the run record's plan_sha256 does not match the plan.
Citrus computes a protocol_semantic_hash different from the plan's.
A fish is named in two arenas or two sessions, or MetaZebrobot shows an earlier usage link for it.

abort_rules.note: No automatic retry; the refusal text goes into the run record.
abort_rules.when: Citrus or Orange refuses START for any reason.
Any H5 of the session seals FAILED.
The Orange preset, config folder or commissioning release the session names is missing on the host.
A non-blank arena of the session has no load confirmation, or an earlier session's arena has no unload confirmation.

abort_rules.note: Jeremy, 2026-11-14: Citrus and Orange both refuse.
abort_rules.when: The plan file is not committed or has edits.

note: Format example. Shows a group from a dish, a single fish from a plate well, a single larva drawn from a dish, and a blank.

preconditions: Projector on before boot or any display-manager restart; projector state read over RS-232 matches the recorded settings (Brightness 50).
Each dish filled to the recorded volume, disc covered, no bubbles (rule fill-fixed-volume).
Commissioning release current for the installed rig config.
Free disk space for the session on the recording volume.

MetaZebrobot (tools/mzb.py subjects): source dish active, dpf inside expected, enough fish; destination dish active and of the same cross; each member alive, in the source dish, with no earlier usage link.
